import json,os,shutil,subprocess,time,traceback
from simulations.extended.design import OUTPUT
from simulations.extended.freeze import science_hashes
from simulations.extended.production import execute
from simulations.provenance import json_write,output_lock,utc_now
protocol=json.loads((OUTPUT/'protocol.json').read_text())
assert science_hashes()==protocol['source_hashes']
record=OUTPUT/'production_recovery_supplement_290_289.json'
state=dict(run_hash=protocol['run_hash'],indices=[290,289],completed_indices=[],pid=os.getpid(),primary_supervisor_pid=28384,started_utc=utc_now(),minimum_disk_free_bytes=3*1024**3,maximum_additional_workers=1,scope='Two existing baseline indices, unchanged frozen production.execute; no additional scientific replications.')
with output_lock(OUTPUT/'recovery_supplement'):
    try:
        for index in state['indices']:
            free=shutil.disk_usage(OUTPUT).free
            state.update(current_index=index,disk_free_before_bytes=free,updated_utc=utc_now())
            primary=subprocess.run(['ps','-p','28384','-o','command='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
            progress=json.loads((OUTPUT/'production_status.json').read_text())
            if free<state['minimum_disk_free_bytes'] or '-m simulations.extended.production --workers 1' not in primary or progress['stage']!='production_baseline' or progress['last_index']>=250:
                state.update(status='stopped_before_next_replication_resource_or_overlap_guard')
                json_write(record,state)
                break
            state.update(status='running')
            json_write(record,state)
            print('Supplement starts existing baseline index',index,flush=True)
            execute(index,protocol,'production_baseline')
            state['completed_indices'].append(index)
            state.update(updated_utc=utc_now())
            json_write(record,state)
        else:
            state.update(status='completed',completed_utc=utc_now())
            json_write(record,state)
    except Exception:
        state.update(status='failed',traceback=traceback.format_exc(),updated_utc=utc_now())
        json_write(record,state)
        raise
